findings.description: The removed block rebuilt `__pydantic_private__` in the copied `__dict__`. On RootModel, private attribute values are kept in `__dict__['__pydantic_private__']`, because the class-level `__pydantic_private__ = None` shadows the slot. Without that block, `copy(self.__dict__)` is shallow, so the copy and the original reference the same private dict. Assigning a private attribute on one instance then silently changes the other. The filter for `PydanticUndefined` placeholders is also gone, so unset-private markers are carried into the copy.
findings.suggestion: Restore the copy of the private dict, with the `PydanticUndefined` filtering, when `__pydantic_private__` is present in `new_dict`.
